responsibility: This file implements an AArch64 RTL pass that renames registers to improve floating-point multiply and fused multiply-add scheduling on Cortex-A57-class tuning profiles. Building on regrename def-use chains, it constructs forests of dependent FMUL/FMADD/FMSUB instructions, tracks parity preferences for the destination and accumulator registers, and renames whole dependency trees to keep pipeline usage balanced and to preserve the favorable destination/accumulator parity relationships expected by the microarchitecture.
